artifactAvailability: Local work/ evidence is ignored by git. PR Engineering regression CI uploads its own screenshots, video, logs and reports as an Actions artifact for the tested SHA; it does not publish the game.
environmentNotes: Chromium 156.0.8078.79 on Linux x64; 1280x720, scale 1, locale zh-CN; difficulty clicks also tested at 1920x1080 and 720x1280.

Initial video attempt failed because the Playwright ffmpeg bundle was missing. Official bundle downloads were blocked by the environment domain policy. The existing /usr/bin/ffmpeg was used via a temporary Playwright executable link; no policy was changed.
Service workers are blocked in browser functional tests for deterministic source loading. Service-worker behavior has separate Node coverage.
Browser import and course fixtures are synthetic test inputs, never game content or official references.
Headless media decoding and advancing clocks do not measure audible output, physical input latency or iPad Safari.
